title.narrative: Increased Access of Women to Economic Opportunities in Turkey
VB Kvinnors ökade ekonomiska deltagande TR

description.narrative: The objective of the programme is to "Support actions aimed at increasing women's labor participation and access to economic opportunities in Turkey". After the 2016 review, the objective has been expanded to also "Address critical barriers to promote an inclusive society, with a focus on addressing gender inequality and specifically deprived communities". The original project had three components: i) Strengthening evidence-based policy making; ii) Knowledge sharing and awareness raising; and iii) Support to women's cooperatives. In 2016, two more components were added; iv) Syrian Refugees Survey and v) Understanding evolving gender norms.

Programmet är ett bilateralt stöd till VB:s Trust Fund “Women’s Access to Economic Opportunities in Turkey”. Programmet har ett avgränsat geografiskt och tematisk fokus och syftar till att stödja pågående initiativ för att öka kvinnors deltagande i arbetslivet. Utöver detta syftar programmet till att dela öka möjligheter för entreprenörskap och kvinnokooperativ genom att stärka evidens-baserade policys, dela information och bedriva medvetandehöjande aktiviteter.

The program is a bilateral contribution to WB’s Trust Fund “Women’s Access to Economic Opportunities in Turkey”. The program has a specific geographical and thematic focus and aims to support ongoing efforts to improve women´s access to more and better jobs in Turkey. It also aims to increase opportunities for entrepreneurship and women’s cooperatives by strengthening evidence-based policy making, facilitating knowledge sharing and raising awareness.

The overall objective of the project was to support actions aimed at increasing women's labour participation and access to economic opportunities in Turkey.
The project has generated more knowledge and understanding of the barriers to women's equality in the labour market in Turkey, through different studies that have been made. The WB TF team has collaborated with NGO's, business associates, think-tanks and academia. Many studies have been performed which has led to a number of reports.
There has been research focusing on barriers to female employment, for instance one study focused on capturing differences in hiring decisions and the outcome was that there was not any evidince that the employers had any gender preference in the recruitment processes.
A team was put together to do a reserach on the situation of women's cooperative in 2014 consisting of Canadian Cooperative Association, Kadin Emegini Degerlendirme Vakfi (KEDV)supported by goernment and other stakeholders. The final report included feedback from MoFSP, Ministry of Customs and Trand, Ministry of Agriculture and livestock , an acedemic expert and the worldbank. The report make several recommendations on how they can work with a broader range of stakeholders and improving monitoring, evaluation and awareness raising, however the support from the government has an important role to play in supporting women's organizations.
Various booklets have been produced focusing on entrepreuneurship, marketing and accounting for women cooperatives.
A study was performed starting 2016 on the request from the Prime Minister office to assess the situation of Syrian refugees in Turkey. They reached out to 50 000 muhtars (headmen) in villages and towns to receive information on the refugee and host community situation and to construct a sample frame and map the number of refugees across districts of the country territory. The result of the study was shared with the Directorate General of Migration Management (DGMM).
The World bank team also engaged with the Turkish government to support the monitoring and evluation of the Emergency Social Safety Net (ESSN)- the cash transfer program funded by EU to support refugees in Turkey.
Regional diaglogues; A platform was set up developed by MoFSP, TUSIAD and WB in 2012. The aim was to create partnership with institutions at the local level to deliver events that respond to specific needs and interests of local women. Some events took place in 2012-2013 but after that it did not continue, despite of an intitial interest from MoFSP.
Multi-stakeholders dialogue; Activities aimed to fascilitate knowledge exchange within specific target sectors to generate a dialogue on women's labor force participation and economic empowerment. Seminars were held, but no progress was seen during 2014-2015 so the component was cancelled.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
